mapper.sql: select a.account_id, a.member_id, m.phone, a.account_type, a.account_name, a.account_no, a.bank_name, a.network, a.is_default, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.remark from biz_pay_account a left join biz_member m on m.member_id = a.member_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_pay_account where member_id = #{memberId} and account_type = #{accountType} and status = '0'
mapper.update: update biz_pay_account set is_default = '0' where member_id = #{memberId} and account_type = #{accountType}
mapper.delete: delete from biz_pay_account where account_id in #{id}
